Iteration 7 achieved a perfect verifier reward by successfully implementing the weighted risk assessment logic and passing all legacy pytest suites.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.71 with zero exceptions across all trials. The pytest suite in 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed in 0.279 seconds, confirming the stability of the hospital capacity calculation. Reusable logic includes the weighted scoring mechanism, but future iterations should re-check edge case handling to improve the judge_reward from 0.71.
